func (observingMethods) Describe(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Ticket) (string, error)
func (observingMethods) Start(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Start) (protocol.Job, error)
func Example[T any](name string) (T, error)
func Forwarded(_ context.Context, wire duplex.Wire) (duplex.Wire, func(), error)
func Local(_ context.Context, wire duplex.Wire) (duplex.Wire, func(), error)
func Mounted(_ context.Context, wire duplex.Wire) (duplex.Wire, func(), error)
func Pair(ctx context.Context, model protocol.ServerModel, options Options) (protocol.ServerModel, func(), error)
func Pipe(ctx context.Context, wire duplex.Wire) (duplex.Wire, func(), error)
func Smoke(ctx context.Context, model protocol.ServerModel, opposite protocol.Client, options Options) error
type Options struct{Context runtime.AdapterContext; RemoteContext runtime.AdapterContext; Presentation Presentation; Inputs map[string]any; Equal func(string, any, any) error}
type Presentation func(context.Context, duplex.Wire) (duplex.Wire, func(), error)
